neighbours.label: the written medium a text goes on or into (note card, envelope, bill), around the medium noun; weak, unclear
fire: Jot each vocabulary word on the front of an index card and the meaning on the back.
Print the return address neatly on the back of the envelope.
The tax provision was quietly included in the spending bill passed on Friday.
Each guest wrote a wish on a small note card and pinned it to the board.
She copied the recipe onto a note card and tucked it into the cookbook.
Write the recipient's name clearly on the front of the envelope.
The clause was buried in the trade bill that the senate approved last night.
Students summarise each chapter on a single note card before the test.
quiet: Say each vocabulary word aloud and then explain its meaning to a partner.
Print the return address neatly and double-check the postcode.
The tax provision was quietly approved by the committee on Friday.
Each guest whispered a wish and lit a candle by the window.
She memorised the recipe and cooked it again the following week.
Say the recipient's name clearly when you hand over the parcel.
The clause was debated for hours before the senate voted last night.
Students summarise each chapter out loud before the test.

notes: Probe: 'note card' 0.59 (peak ' note'), 'included in the bill' 0.56 (peak ' in'), 'front of the envelope' 0.43 (peak ' of').
